content.short: Nested lets you create a personalized finance system and generate passive income.
content.description: Nested combines non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and decentralized finance (DeFi) to support personal finance with an open, intuitive platform. It merges NFT capabilities with DeFi features to build a finance system tailored to individual needs. Investors can create, modify, and replicate their portfolios without requiring technical expertise. Each NFT represents an investor's portfolio and can be updated and tracked within the Nested Finance app. Users may earn royalties by offering their NFTs for others to replicate their investment strategy.
